name: Objective 06 development paraphrase set
status: DEVELOPMENT MATERIAL (D-108). GAP_GROUPING_THRESHOLD is chosen on this set and on nothing else. It shares no subject with the thirty seeded queries (salary review, corporate card, christmas shutdown, jury duty, and the Administrator-only subjects), so the thirty stay a test set (D-93).
written: 8 November 2026. Twelve subjects the corpus can answer, each in three wordings: two questions phrased differently and one search-style term. Every cross-subject pair is a negative; the pairs listed under hard_negatives share a document or a vocabulary and are reported separately.
rule: Embed every item with the query prefix. Within-subject similarities are the positives, every cross-subject pair is a negative. If the lowest positive exceeds the highest negative, the threshold is the midpoint between them; otherwise the value with the best pairwise F1. D-40's drift margin (0.006) is reported against the gap either way.
